instructions:
# Idempotency

Send and handle idempotent requests the way payment APIs do.

## What this skill does

- Uses Idempotency-Key headers on mutating requests.
- Caches first responses and replays them verbatim.
- Runs retry loops safely with curl --retry.
- Verifies replays return identical bodies and status codes.

## When to use

- Integrating with APIs that document Idempotency-Key (Stripe, Shopify...).
- Adding retry logic without duplicate side effects.
- Testing your own API's replay behavior.

## Real commands

```bash
# Stripe-style request
curl -X POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges -u sk_test_x: \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: abc123" -d amount=100 -d currency=usd

# Two calls, one key: responses must be identical
curl -s -X POST -H "Idempotency-Key: k1" http://localhost:8080/v1/payments -d amount=100 -o r1.json
curl -s -X POST -H "Idempotency-Key: k1" http://localhost:8080/v1/payments -d amount=100 -o r2.json
diff r1.json r2.json

# Server-side cache key
redis-cli SETEX idem:k1 60 done

# Retry with the same key across attempts
curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors -X POST -H "Idempotency-Key: 9x" \
  http://localhost:8080/v1/payments -d amount=10
```

## Client retry loop

```bash
KEY="$(uuidgen)"
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -s -X POST -H "Idempotency-Key: $KEY" http://localhost:8080/v1/payments -d amount=10 && break
  sleep 2
done
```

## Testing

```bash
# Same key, different payload must be rejected
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST -H "Idempotency-Key: k1" http://localhost:8080/v1/payments -d amount=200
# expect 409/422 conflict
```

## Best practices

- Generate the key client-side (UUID) before the first attempt.
- Keep the key stable across all retries of one logical operation.
- Store the canonical response (status + body) server-side under the key.
- Expire entries to bound storage; clients accept a new key after expiry.

## Example exchange

```
User: Retry the payment request safely after a timeout.
Agent: Reuse one key for all attempts:
       curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors -X POST -H "Idempotency-Key: 9x" http://localhost:8080/v1/payments -d amount=10
```
